— True Blackstart

Restarts from solar alone.
No grid required.

AURA cold-starts from a fully depleted state using only solar input. Most competing systems require grid presence to restart — Deye doesn't. Combined with 2× rated power surge for 10 seconds, it handles startup loads that trip other systems.

— Battery Solutions

Modular batteries.
Pair with any Deye inverter.

For installations where you need a separate inverter and battery configuration — choose from rack-mounted or wall-mounted LFP modules, scalable from 5 kWh to over 300 kWh.

Rack-Mounted Battery

SE-G5.1 Pro-B

5.12 kWh per module. Rack-mounted, wall-mounted, or floor-mounted. Modular design scales up to 64 units in parallel — max 327 kWh. Pairs with 3.6–8 kW single-phase or three-phase inverters. LFP chemistry, intelligent BMS, IP20.

5.12 kWh/module Max 327 kWh LFP 10yr warranty
Learn more
Wall-Mounted Battery

RW-F10.2

10.2 kWh per module. Wall-mounted or floor-mounted. High-performance 1C/1.2C charge and discharge with 300A peak current. Up to 32 units in parallel — max 326 kWh. IP65 rated for full outdoor installation. Pairs with 8–20 kW inverters.

10.2 kWh/module Max 326 kWh IP65 1C/1.2C
Learn more
— Hybrid Inverters

Residential hybrid inverters.
Single-phase & three-phase.

Pair with SE-G5.1 Pro or RW-F10.2 batteries for a complete energy storage system. VPP ready, pure off-grid capable, up to 16 inverters in parallel.

Single-Phase

1PH Hybrid Inverter

3.6–16 kW output. Max 16 inverters in parallel with up to 32 batteries. Ultra 4ms on-grid to off-grid switching. Six time periods for battery scheduling. Diesel generator ready. AC coupling retrofit compatible.

3.6–16 kW VPP Ready Off-Grid
Learn more
Three-Phase

3PH Hybrid Inverter

5–20 kW output. 100% unbalanced output per phase — up to 50% rated power. Max 16 inverters in parallel. Same battery compatibility, same off-grid capability, optimised for three-phase Australian homes.

5–20 kW VPP Ready 3PH Balance
